The '''A2.50-grade ion engine''' was a [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]]. The [[Conqueror-class assault ship|''Conqueror''-class assault ship]] was fitted with four of the [[Engine/Legends|engines]], along with four [[A2-grade ion engine]]s.<ref name="EGVV" />
